name: Image WebP Converter
description: Converts already-uploaded images to WebP and rewrites the stored filenames and references that point at them.
project_description: Image WebP Converter converts images that are already stored on a Drupal site into WebP, then rewrites the file entity's filename and MIME type and updates the content references that point at it. Conversion is performed by the rosell-dk/webp-convert PHP library, with a choice of three back-ends (GD, cwebp, or Imagick) selected on a settings form. It offers three ways to convert: a site-wide batch process over every managed JPEG/PNG file, an opt-in per-node checkbox that converts a node's image fields and inline CKEditor images on save, and a standalone upload-and-download form that converts a single uploaded image. Unlike core image-style WebP derivatives, which leave the source files untouched, this module replaces the source images in place and the operation is not reversible.
